facts: Parties: Corrib Logistics plc (Buyer), Glenrock Capital LLP (Seller); the Company is Oakhurst Industries Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 6 September 2026; Closing is scheduled for 9 December 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,250,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $10,000,000.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 24 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Present: 2 directors (of 5). The meeting was quorate. RESOLVED to approve entry into the Share Purchase Agreement.
Article 11: the quorum for board meetings is three directors.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $5,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $4,800,000.
